visit_ranking.name: Riverbend Farm
visit_ranking.ranking_basis: Ongoing fault; feasible one-hour intervention first, then reference support and affected hours; ordinal policy, not expected utility.
visit_ranking.work: Check the anemometer model, output units and logger coefficient, then verify against its specification and an independent reference.
visit_ranking.reason: The continuing large wind-ratio change has consistent reference-omission support and a plausible configuration fix within one hour.
visit_ranking.tools: Sensor manual/model list, logger interface, known-compatible spare and portable wind reference.
visit_ranking.plan: 0-10 min: photograph model and configuration; 10-25: check units, wiring and coefficient; 25-45: compare simultaneous speed readings; 45-60: correct only a documented mismatch and repeat the comparison.
visit_ranking.verification: Document the configured units/coefficient and compare several readings across changing wind; use manufacturer tolerance, without assuming the historical ratio is a calibration factor.
visit_ranking.contingency: If no specification/reference or a safe representative comparison is available, log findings, leave calibration unchanged and keep future wind on hold.
visit_ranking.remote: Request the model/configuration photograph before travel; cancel the visit if a verified remote fix passes comparison.

visit_ranking.name: North Mesa School
visit_ranking.ranking_basis: Ongoing fault; feasible one-hour intervention first, then reference support and affected hours; ordinal policy, not expected utility.
visit_ranking.work: Compare station pressure with a calibrated reference at the same height; check the replacement board and record any adjustment.
visit_ranking.reason: Pressure is still affected, but a defensible adjustment requires a calibrated reference; this becomes first choice if that kit is available and the wind configuration is resolved remotely.
visit_ranking.tools: Calibrated station-pressure reference, board documentation and logger interface.
visit_ranking.plan: 0-15 min: check board/settings; 15-40: co-locate and compare pressure; 40-60: apply only a documented adjustment and verify again.
visit_ranking.verification: Agreement within combined instrument specification at the same height; retain before/after readings and settings.
visit_ranking.contingency: Without a calibrated reference, inspect settings only and retain the pressure hold.
visit_ranking.remote: Obtain the replacement-board specification and current settings before dispatch.

visit_ranking.name: Foothills Community Garden
visit_ranking.ranking_basis: Ongoing fault; feasible one-hour intervention first, then reference support and affected hours; ordinal policy, not expected utility.
visit_ranking.work: Inspect shield ventilation, mounting and nearby surfaces; compare with a shaded reference thermometer in sunlight.
visit_ranking.reason: Exposure bias is probable, but cause and onset are uncertain; a daylight diagnosis may need longer than one visit.
visit_ranking.tools: Shielded calibrated thermometer, mounting inspection kit and sunshine during the visit.
visit_ranking.plan: Inspect exposure, co-locate a shielded reference, compare through sun/shade changes, document any intervention.
visit_ranking.verification: A stable sunlight comparison within instrument tolerances, with no unexplained day/night difference.
visit_ranking.contingency: Arrange a longer co-location if conditions are cloudy or a one-hour comparison is inconclusive.
visit_ranking.remote: Check siting photographs; do not assign the cause from the maintenance note alone.

visit_ranking.name: Eastside Rec Centre
visit_ranking.ranking_basis: Ongoing fault; feasible one-hour intervention first, then reference support and affected hours; ordinal policy, not expected utility.
visit_ranking.work: Reconcile installation sheets and logger identity remotely before a coordinate-verification visit.
visit_ranking.reason: Coordinate-dependent use is restricted; a remote metadata check can resolve this before spending the field hour.
visit_ranking.tools: Installation history, logger serial number and GNSS receiver.
visit_ranking.plan: Reconcile identity, then verify the physical location if necessary.
visit_ranking.verification: Inventory, serial number and independent position agree.
